name: Custom Memory Allocator
description: Implement malloc and free from scratch in C, managing a heap with free lists and coalescing blocks. Explore first-fit and best-fit strategies.

name: Unix Shell
description: Build a bash-like shell in C supporting piping, redirection, background processes, and job control signals.

name: ELF Binary Parser
description: Parse and inspect Linux ELF executables, reading symbol tables, section headers, and program headers from raw bytes.

name: REST API Server
description: Build a REST API with JWT authentication, rate limiting, and PostgreSQL persistence. Include OpenAPI documentation.

name: Full Stack Todo App
description: Create a full stack web application with a React frontend, REST backend, user accounts, and a database. Deploy to the cloud.

name: Real Time Chat App
description: Build a browser-based chat application using WebSockets for real time messaging, with rooms, presence indicators, and message history.

name: Image Classifier
description: Train a convolutional neural network to classify images using PyTorch. Fine-tune a pretrained ResNet on a custom dataset.

name: Sentiment Analysis Pipeline
description: Build an NLP pipeline to classify sentiment in text using transformers. Fine-tune BERT on a labeled dataset and serve predictions via an API.
